    "/aikido-fix" : {
      "post" : {
        "summary" : "Submit an Aikido-driven fix job",
        "description" : "Resolves vulnerability context from Aikido Security (package, versions, CVE, changelog) using either a JIRA key or an Aikido issue group ID. Builds an enriched prompt with full vulnerability details, auto-generates a branch name, and uses 'develop' as the base branch. After the PR is created, optionally triggers an Aikido CI scan to verify the fix.",
        "operationId" : "aikidoFix",
        "tags" : [ "Aikido" ],
        "requestBody" : {
          "description" : "JIRA key and/or Aikido issue group ID",
          "content" : {
            "application/json" : {
              "schema" : {
                "$ref" : "#/components/schemas/AikidoFixRequest"
              }
            }
          },
          "required" : true
        },
        "responses" : {
          "202" : {
            "description" : "Job accepted and queued",
            "content" : {
              "application/json" : {
                "schema" : {
                  "examples" : [ {
                    "jobId" : "...",
                    "branch" : "agent/JTP-10967-upgrade-log4j",
                    "aikidoIssue" : {
                      "package" : "log4j-core",
                      "cve" : "CVE-2024-XXXXX"
                    }
                  } ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400" : {
            "description" : "Missing fields or Aikido issue not found"
          },
          "429" : {
            "description" : "Job queue is full"
          },
          "503" : {
            "description" : "Aikido integration not configured"
          }
        }
      }
    },

          "202" : {
            "description" : "Job accepted and queued",
            "content" : {
              "application/json" : {
                "schema" : {

              }
            }
          },
          "400" : {
            "description" : "Missing required fields",
            "content" : {
              "application/json" : {
                "schema" : {
                  "examples" : [ {
                    "error" : "repoUrl is required"

              }

          },
          "429" : {
            "description" : "Job queue is full",

                "schema" : {
                  "examples" : [ {
                    "error" : "Job queue is full"
                  } ]
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

Here's a summary of everything I found and fixed in `src/pages/NewJob.tsx`:

| Job type | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `SYNC_CONFLUENCE` | Not in the form at all | Added → `POST /sync-confluence` with `repoUrl` (required) + `branchName`, `docsPath`, `confluenceSpaceKey`, `confluenceParentPageId` |
| `QUALITY_REPORT` | Not in the form at all | Added → `POST /metrics/quality-reports/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/{branch}` — takes `workspace`, `repoSlug`, `branch` as path params + optional `repoUrl` in body |
| `METRICS` | Was incorrectly pointing to `/run-fix` | Corrected to `POST /plans/improve-quality` with `repoUrl` + `branch` (required) + optional `targetBranch` |

**Additional improvements:**
- Extracted `FieldConfig` and `JobTypeConfig` interfaces so the config is typed properly.
- Added a `isPathParam` flag on fields — the submit handler now splits fields between path params (interpolated into the URL) and body fields, so path-param endpoints like Quality Report work correctly.
- The dropdown now shows human-readable labels (e.g. "Sync to Confluence") instead of raw enum names.

Here's what changed in `NewJob.tsx`:

**Repository selector**
- Added a `useQuery` to fetch all repos from `GET /settings/repos`
- Replaced every `repoUrl` text input with a single **Repository** select box
- Archived repos are excluded from all lists
- The submit button is disabled until a repo is selected
- If the filtered list is empty, shows "No repositories configured for this job type" helper text

**Per-job-type filtering** via `repoFilter`:

| Job type | Filter |
|---|---|
| FIX | not archived |
| REVIEW | `reviewEnabled` |
| GENERATE_TESTS | not archived |
| GENERATE_DOCS | `docsEnabled` |
| METRICS | not archived |
| QUALITY_REPORT | `qualityReportEnabled` |
| SYNC_CONFLUENCE | `docsEnabled` |

**Submit handler**
- Constructs `repoUrl` automatically as `${VITE_BITBUCKET_URL}/{workspace}/{repoSlug}.git` from the selected repo
- For `QUALITY_REPORT`, `workspace` and `repoSlug` are also injected into the path-param endpoint template automatically — the user only needs to type the branch
